from django.db.models import OuterRef,Subquery,Exists,Q,Count
from django.utils import timezone
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferObservation
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q
now=timezone.now()
q=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q(now),is_active=True,owner_hidden=False)
latest=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk")).order_by("-observed_at","-pk")
anyavailable=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk"),availability="AVAILABLE")
anypriced=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk"),price__isnull=False,currency__isnull=False)
anydelivery=OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id=OuterRef("pk")).filter(Q(delivery_days__isnull=False)|Q(search_delivery_days__isnull=False))
q=q.annotate(latest_availability=Subquery(latest.values("availability")[:1]),last_observed=Subquery(latest.values("observed_at")[:1]),has_historical_available=Exists(anyavailable),has_any_price=Exists(anypriced),has_any_delivery_days=Exists(anydelivery)).distinct()
print("ELIGIBLE="+str(q.count()))
print("LATEST_UNKNOWN="+str(q.filter(latest_availability="UNKNOWN").count()))
print("HISTORICALLY_AVAILABLE="+str(q.filter(has_historical_available=True).count()))
print("ANY_PRICE_AVAILABLE="+str(q.filter(has_any_price=True).count()))
print("ANY_DELIVERY_DAYS="+str(q.filter(has_any_delivery_days=True).count()))
print("OBSERVATION_NEWEST="+str(q.order_by("-last_observed").values_list("last_observed",flat=True).first()))
print("OBSERVATION_OLDEST="+str(q.order_by("last_observed").values_list("last_observed",flat=True).first()))
print("CROSSCHECK_DB=PASS")
'
